🎶 Mark your calendar: Saturday, August 22 — a full day of live music in Newton, noon to 2 AM. Artist spotlights all week long. If you want to get your boogie on, come on down. 🎸 Murph & Mary's, Newton IA.

🎸 Kicking off the day at noon: Brian James, a.k.a. B-Ray — reggae, folk, bluegrass, hip hop and blues all rolled into one. A Des Moines native and Newton local (and former member of Strang Dang Doodle), mixing his own originals with classic covers. Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.
Up at 1:00: Mike Street brings his own sound to the stage — come find out what he's all about. 🎸 Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎸 Ben Hamilton — a central-Iowa singer-songwriter who traded the mandolin for a 4-string tenor guitar in Irish tuning. Blues, jam bands, and bluegrass with a soulful spin, plus originals in his back pocket. A rare solo appearance (he's usually half of Improv N Hard Copies). Catch him at 2:15! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎶 Micah Spurlock — an indie-folk artist whose music explores the quiet landscapes of human experience, honest self-reflection, and the long road home. Acoustic storytelling and raw, reflective lyrics. On at 3:30! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎸 Mancat Biegger — a working musician since 1987 who's played stages all across the country and picked up just about every style along the way: rock & roll, funk, soul, blues, jazz fusion, Americana and beyond. A hot, personal take on every song. On at 4:45! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🤠 James Wood — straight out of the Texas panhandle and now calling Iowa home. Old-school storytelling meets southern rock, with a debut album on the way (Hotels, Honky-tonks and Heartaches). Member of the Texas Country Music Association. On at 7:00! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.
✨ Kelanie Crosswait — a songwriter who turns life experience into messages of love and healing, hoping to spark a little more self-love in everyone listening. On at 8:45! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎸 Closing out the live music: David Wayne Redfearn — groove-driven blues, funk, folk, rock & reggae, originals plus unexpected covers. If you want to get your boogie on, come on down. 10 PM till midnight! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎧 Taking us into the night: DJ Jorgy! Got his start DJing a 6th-grade student-vs-teacher basketball game in the Quad Cities, and nearly 28 years later he's here. A true open-format DJ — expect hip hop, pop, hard rock, dance, and a couple of goofy ones to match the vibe. "If you don't love it, leave it — USA #1." Midnight–2 AM! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

Every song starts the same way — one chord, played before you're ready. 🎸 You don't wait to feel brave. You play the first chord and the bravery shows up after. Whatever you've been putting off, strum it today. — David Wayne Redfearn

Nobody claps for the calluses. 🎸 But every clean note you've ever heard was paid for in sore fingertips and quiet practice nobody saw. Whatever you're grinding on in private — it's counting. Keep at it.
Not every song needs to be loud to be heard. 🎶 Some of the truest things get said soft. Be gentle with yourself today — and with the folks around you. Softness is strength too.
Funny thing about old strings — you think they're worn out, then you write your best song on 'em. 🎸 You're not too old, too late, or too far gone for a new song. Tune up. Start where you are. — DWR
Somewhere out there, somebody needs exactly the song only you can play. 🎶 Don't sit on it. Don't wait till it's perfect. Play it, post it, share it — you never know whose hard day you'll carry.

Music taught me this: the rest between the notes is part of the song. 🎸 Silence isn't you falling behind — it's you making room for the next beautiful thing. Give yourself a rest today. You've earned the space.

Out of tune isn't broken. It just means it's time to listen closer and adjust. 🎶 Same with a rough season — you're not broken, you're just a little out of tune. Take a breath. Tune one string at a time.

You don't get good at guitar by loving guitar. You get good by playing it — badly, over and over, till it's beautiful. 🎸 Same with patience. Same with kindness. Same with love. Whatever you want more of, practice it today.

The best jams I've ever been part of started with somebody just... pulling up a chair. 🎸 You don't need a stage or a setlist. You need a porch, a guitar, and good people. Come as you are — there's always room in the circle.

The song you almost didn't write is usually the one somebody needed most. 🎶 That idea you keep talking yourself out of? Write it. Sing it. Build it. The world doesn't need it perfect. It needs it made. — David Wayne Redfearn
Turn the noise down for three minutes. 🎧 Not your speakers — the world. The comparing, the scrolling, the rush. Pick up something you love, or put on a song that feels like home, and just... breathe.

However today treated you, let it go easy now. 🎸 Love to the ones who are tired. Peace to the ones still working it out. Light to all of us. The song's not over — it just gets to rest till morning. Goodnight, friends. 🎶💛 — David Wayne Redfearn
